Definition: properly, to eye or (generally) to heed, i.e. pay attention; by implication, to respond; by extension to begin to speak; specifically to sing, shout, testify, announce
BiblicalUsage: 1) to answer, respond, testify, speak, shout; 1a) (Qal); 1a1) to answer, respond to; 1a2) to testify, respond as a witness; 1b) (Niphal); 1b1) to make answer; 1b2) to be answered, receive answer; 2) (Qal) to sing, utter tunefully; 3) (Qal) to dwell
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
